coverage: All eleven local sections and both English editions: complete named cast and references, speaking roles, scoped groups and divine titles. No generic pronoun or place-name inference.

entities.name: Oedipus
entities.body: The blind former king of Thebes, now an exile traveling with his daughter Antigone.

entities.name: Antigone
entities.body: Oedipus’s daughter and guide during his exile.

entities.name: Ismene
entities.body: Oedipus’s daughter and Antigone’s sister.

entities.name: Theseus
entities.body: The king of Athens, son of Aegeus.

entities.name: Creon
entities.body: The Theban statesman, Jocasta’s brother and uncle of Oedipus’s children.

entities.name: Polyneices
entities.body: Oedipus’s elder son and brother of Eteocles, Antigone and Ismene.

entities.name: The elders of Colonus
entities.body: The local elders who speak for the community at Colonus.

entities.name: The local stranger
entities.body: The resident of Colonus who first explains the sacred ground to Oedipus.

entities.name: The messenger
entities.body: An attendant of Theseus who reports what happens away from the stage.

entities.name: The Eumenides
entities.body: The avenging goddesses whose sacred grove is at Colonus, respectfully called the Gracious Ones.

entities.name: Creon’s men
entities.body: The attendants who accompany Creon from Thebes.

entities.name: Theseus’s men
entities.body: The Athenian attendants and fighters serving Theseus.

entities.name: Jocasta
entities.body: Oedipus’s mother and wife, the mother of his children and sister of Creon.

entities.name: Laius
entities.body: Oedipus’s father, an earlier king of Thebes.

entities.name: Labdacus
entities.body: Laius’s father and Oedipus’s grandfather.

entities.name: Eteocles
entities.body: Oedipus’s younger son, Polyneices’s rival for the throne of Thebes. Printed Etocles in the original.

entities.name: Adrastus
entities.body: The king of Argos and father-in-law of Polyneices.

entities.name: Polyneices’s wife
entities.body: The daughter of Adrastus whom Polyneices marries in Argos.

entities.name: Amphiaraus
entities.body: The warrior and seer among the champions marching with Polyneices. Printed Amphiaraiis in the original.

entities.name: Tydeus
entities.body: The Aetolian champion, son of Oeneus, allied with Polyneices.

entities.name: Oeneus
entities.body: Tydeus’s father.

entities.name: Eteoclus
entities.body: The Argive champion allied with Polyneices; distinct from Oedipus’s son Eteocles.

entities.name: Hippomedon
entities.body: One of the Argive champions marching with Polyneices.

entities.name: Talaos
entities.body: The father of Hippomedon in the genealogy given here.

entities.name: Capaneus
entities.body: The champion who boasts of burning Thebes.

entities.name: Parthenopaeus
entities.body: The Arcadian champion, son of Atalanta, allied with Polyneices.

entities.name: Atalanta
entities.body: The legendary huntress and mother of Parthenopaeus.

entities.name: Aegeus
entities.body: Theseus’s father and former king of Athens.

entities.name: Pelops
entities.body: The legendary hero whose name is associated with the Peloponnese.

entities.name: Peirithous
entities.body: The hero and companion of Theseus, recalled through their pact.

entities.name: Colonus
entities.body: The local hero and patron from whom the district takes its name.

entities.name: Poseidon
entities.body: The god of the sea and horses, worshipped at Colonus.

entities.name: Prometheus
entities.body: The fire-bearing Titan honored near the sacred grove.

entities.name: Apollo
entities.body: The god of prophecy, also called Phoebus.

entities.name: Athena
entities.body: The patron goddess of Athens, also called Pallas and Athene.

entities.name: Zeus
entities.body: The chief Olympian god, associated with thunder and the protection of suppliants.

entities.name: Dionysus
entities.body: The god of wine and ecstatic worship, celebrated here as the Bacchic god.

entities.name: The nymphs
entities.body: The nature spirits who cared for the young Dionysus.

entities.name: The Muses
entities.body: The goddesses of song and the arts.

entities.name: Aphrodite
entities.body: The goddess of love, called the Cyprian here.

entities.name: Kronos
entities.body: The Titan who is father of Poseidon and Zeus.

entities.name: The Nereids
entities.body: The sea nymphs whose dancing feet appear in the chorus’s image of swift oars.

entities.name: Ares
entities.body: The god of war, associated with the Athenian hill called the Areopagus.

entities.name: Rhea
entities.body: The mother of Poseidon and other Olympian gods.

entities.name: Artemis
entities.body: The hunting goddess and sister of Apollo.

entities.name: Demeter
entities.body: The mother goddess worshipped with her daughter Persephone in the Eleusinian mysteries.

entities.name: Persephone
entities.body: The queen of the underworld and daughter of Demeter, also called Persephassa.

entities.name: The Eumolpidae
entities.body: The priestly family associated with the secret rites at Eleusis.

entities.name: Hermes
entities.body: The god who guides the souls of the dead.

entities.name: Hades
entities.body: The ruler of the underworld, addressed as Aidoneus.

entities.name: Cerberus
entities.body: The watchdog guarding the entrance to the underworld.

entities.name: Death
entities.body: The divine power of death addressed as the giver of eternal sleep.

entities.name: Earth
entities.body: The primordial divine Earth, named in the genealogy of the sacred powers.

entities.name: Night
entities.body: The primordial power of darkness associated with the avenging goddesses.
